claims: The frozen GPUModelRunner._prepare_input_ids scatters previous live GPU draft outputs by prev_positions into scheduled speculative slots. CPU -1 slots carry width only.
The captured unreindexed MTP first-pass input positions and IDs follow the target hidden rows; merged step-zero query ends partition those rows by the captured live request order.
Only immediately previous same-request device producers may resolve uniform -1 slots. Retained prefixes must independently agree with current device first-pass IDs and native retained IDs.
Actual device positions replace optimistic host starts only in a separate derived input view. Original streams and failed receipts remain immutable.

CorrectedWorker.load_model unconditionally installs CausalLengths outside the native merged runnable. The raw observer wraps that object and therefore observes step-one device lengths both before and after its publication.

causal_draft_lengths.publish changes only the second-step device length to selected first-pass position + 2 on the caller stream before draft_fia.Runnable invokes Frame.prepare and copies the actual lengths. First-step device lengths and all host envelopes remain unchanged.

A first-pass sampled row causally reads its own prefix within the full contiguous query segment. Device KV extent binds the segment end, including rejected padding rows; a retained full/logit root ends at the selected position. No discarded suffix is charged as a necessary dependency.
